tools.name: get_account_stats
tools.description: Clicks and QR scans across every link in the user's Snip.link account: totals, by day, the busiest links, and the top countries, referring sites and devices. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: make_qr_code, save_page, drop_file, list_domains · Private data: make_qr_code, shorten_link, drop_file, get_link_stats, list_domains · Public sink: make_qr_code, drop_file, update_link, list_domains · Destructive: save_page, drop_file, delete_link.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: make_qr_code, save_page, drop_file, list_domains · Private data: make_qr_code, shorten_link, drop_file, get_link_stats, list_domains · Public sink: make_qr_code, drop_file, update_link, list_domains · Destructive: save_page, drop_file, delete_link

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
